headline: Microchip author reports reusable UVM agents for UDN and UPF analog stimulus
fact: A Microchip-authored paper reports bidirectional UVM agents for SystemVerilog user-defined nettypes and UPF supply-net pins. The agents generate static and time-varying analog stimulus, monitor values, and are configured through reusable objects; the paper reports using the approach with the three largest simulators and discusses portability differences among them.

sources.title: Bi-Directional UVM Agents and Complex Stimulus Generation for UDN and UPF Pins
sources.summary: 2021 Microchip paper describing reusable UVM agents, analog waveform generation, monitoring, configuration, and simulator portability for UDN and UPF pins.
